column2: Retain Jehoram son of Ahab, accession in Jehoshaphat's eighteenth year and twelve-year reign. Unlike the earlier lettered notice, this verse uses past became king/reigned; the separate account is not collapsed into the earlier present-tense statement.

Retain the evil evaluation qualified by father and mother, and the removal of plural Baal pillars made by his father. Father here differs from brothers in 1:18b; shattering from 1:18c is not imported into this shorter notice.

Retain singular sin of Jeroboam son of Nebat, causing Israel to sin, clinging and not turning away. The singular differs from the earlier plural house's sins; no attempt is made to standardize the two notices.

Retain the inherited noqed and at the rising as explicitly unresolved expressions. Both hundred-thousand figures and rams in their fleeces remain. Mesha is the inherited English form for selected Mosa, and no annual schedule or confidently identified profession is supplied.
column3: What do noqed and en te epanastasei mean in this tribute description, and does in their fleeces denote live rams or a wool assessment?

column2: Retain Ahab's death as the temporal setting of Moab's king breaking faith with Israel's king. The statement repeats the breach without explaining the exact treaty or tribute terms beyond the neighboring notice.
Retain Jehoram's departure from Samaria that day and the muster of Israel. The collective Israel is not expanded into a precise number or only a particular troop type.

Retain the going and sending, Moab's breach, invitation to war and affirmative response. The person/people/horses comparisons remain, with no additional equipment or conditions; the reply is ordinary human speech.

Retain the question about which road and the wilderness route of Edom. The two he said subjects are unexpressed in Greek and remain unnamed, so the inherited wording does not pretend that the speakers are fully resolved.
column3: Which king asks and which answers the route question; would explicit names be justified by the surrounding dialogue?

column2: Retain all three kings, the seven-day circuit, and lack of water for camp and livestock at their feet. The feet image identifies accompanying animals provisionally without asserting a particular military formation or a seven-day straight route.

Retain the king's lament, the Lord's calling of the three passing-through kings and their delivery into Moab's singular hand. This is the king's fearful interpretation, not an added narrator judgment; the passing-through participle is not silently omitted.

Retain Jehoshaphat's negative question and the attendant's identification of Elisha son of Shaphat through his pouring water on Elijah's hands. That concrete service is not replaced with only a generic disciple title.
Retain a word of the Lord with Elisha and all three kings descending to him. The full Judah title for Jehoshaphat remains, and the visit is not reduced to a messenger's inquiry.

Retain Elisha's distancing question and the father's prophets only. The king's No and repeated explanation about the Lord handing the three kings into Moab's hands remain; mother's prophets are not supplied from another form of the account.

Retain the living Lord of hosts oath, standing before Him, regard for Jehoshaphat and the hypothetical refusal even to look at Israel's king. The negative force of the second elliptical if construction is expressed through would neither ... nor; no actual refusal to give the following oracle is asserted.

Retain the request for a string player and the hand of the Lord coming upon him during the playing. Player of strings is broader than an identified harp. Him is contextually likely Elisha but the nearest named participant is the player, so the subject relation remains recorded rather than silently settled.
column3: Should upon him be clarified as upon Elisha, and how specifically can the instrument be identified from psallo here?

column2: Retain the divine command to make the torrent bed pit after pit. The doubled pits are preserved as a repeated distributive image rather than replaced by an unspecified ditch; no unexpressed depth or engineering method is supplied.

Retain seeing neither wind nor rain, the torrent bed filled, and the three drinking parties: you, your possessions and your livestock. Possessions follows kteseis but its metonymic reference is unresolved; it is not silently collapsed into livestock alone.
column3: Does possessions denote acquired dependents, herds or another accompanying group, and is see wind intentionally retained as the selected sensory verb?

column2: Retain the third-person Lord's eyes followed by first-person I will hand Moab over. The speaker shift within the oracle is not normalized to He, and the light/easy description of the water provision remains.

Retain the future actions against every fortified city, every good tree, all water springs and every good plot. These selected comprehensive judgments are not softened or expanded with an absent chosen-city phrase; the repeated every/all has explicit support.

Retain morning and the sacrifice's ascent, the presentative look, waters coming from Edom and the land's filling. The offering type is not narrowed to a grain offering, nor is rain in Edom inserted as a narrated mechanism.

Retain all Moab hearing, the raised cry, everyone wearing a belt and upward, and the border position. The belted-age wording is not turned into a precise age threshold or supplied sword-bearing requirement.
column3: Does the belt expression denote military eligibility or age, and what is the most natural way to retain the selected and upward formula?

column2: Retain early rising, sunlight over the water and Moab's seeing fiery-red water like blood. The appearance is reported from their perspective; the water is not asserted actually to have become blood.

Retain the mistaken blood-from-the-sword explanation, kings fighting and each striking his neighbor, followed by the call to spoil. The inference belongs to Moab's speakers and is not a narrator's account of an allied battle.

Retain Moab's entry into Israel's camp, Israel's attack, the flight and continued pursuit/striking. The last they is contextually Israel after the Moabite flight; the English keeps the selected repeated entering image without adding a named destination absent here.
column3: Would explicitly naming Israel in the last sentence improve the change of subject without overstating the elliptical entering construction?

column2: Retain destroyed cities, each man's stone on good plots, blocked springs and felled good trees. The selected wall-stones-demolished clause and slingers' attack remain without substituting the familiar named surviving fortress. It has an unresolved feminine city referent.
column3: What does leaving the wall's stones demolished mean, and which city does the final it denote without an explicit name in this selected wording?

column2: Retain the overwhelming battle, seven hundred drawn-sword men and the attempted breakthrough toward Edom's king. Their failure remains explicit; no change to Syria or Israel is made to simplify the military situation.

Retain the firstborn son, the selected past had reigned, whole burnt offering on the wall, great regret upon Israel and withdrawal. The past reign is not converted to would reign, and regret is not replaced by divine wrath. The possessive naturally refers to Moab's king but its relation to the preceding Edom episode merits review.
column3: How should the past reign and son antecedent be understood; what force does metamelos carry here, and who experiences or produces the regret without an explicitly named deity?
